effectiveTerms: MIT for the Godot Engine and for this core; the third-party libraries inside Godot under their own permissive licences (zlib, BSD, MIT, Apache-2.0, the FreeType Project License and others), listed with their texts in Godot's COPYRIGHT.txt; MIT for Mesa; Apache-2.0 with the LLVM exception for LLVM
note: The built core combines this repository's code (MIT): the Chimera module in module/chimera and the build scripts; the Godot Engine (MIT), compiled from the submodule extern/godot (4.6.3-stable) as an export template for Linux with this repository's patches/ applied, which includes the third-party libraries Godot ships in its thirdparty/ folder (FreeType, HarfBuzz, ICU, libpng, libjpeg-turbo, libwebp, libogg, libvorbis, libtheora, mbed TLS, PCRE2, ThorVG, zlib, zstd, Brotli, Jolt Physics and others), each under the licence COPYRIGHT.txt gives; Mesa (MIT), whose llvmpipe driver behind OSMesa is the OpenGL Godot draws with (with this repository's waterbox/mesa-patches applied); and LLVM (Apache-2.0 with the LLVM exception), which llvmpipe compiles the shaders with. The package carries no game: the project brings the game's .pck.
